dslRule:
<!id: add.semicolon.to.method.args.triggers>
<!description: Add semicolon as a trigger for method proposals with arguments, updating a static char array initializer literal.>
<!severity: INFO>
new char[] { '(', '-', ' ' }
=>
new char[] { ';', '(', '-', ' ' }
;;
summary: Adds the semicolon character to a specific character array literal initializer that defines method argument triggers.
